2608.24691.title: Confident at the moment of action: belief miscalibration in LLM play under hidden information
2608.24691.paper_summary: Agentic systems increasingly gate actions on a model's own stated confidence, which assumes confidence tracks correctness at the moment of acting. We test this in a hidden-information chess variant where royal status can be secretly, repeatedly relocated between pieces, and where an agent's stated probability distribution over the opponent's hidden royal piece -- elicited every turn, separately from the move it chooses -- is scored against ground truth recoverable after the game. Across two independent batches, captures made at high stated confidence ($\geq 0.5$) about the hidden piece's location were correct in 1 of 62 cases. The calibration deficit is concentrated almost entirely in these events: 99.3% of it in the original batch, 98.7% in the replication. The same pattern, in weaker form, orders consistently (point estimates only; most pairwise gaps are not statistically distinguishable at this sample size) across four further model configurations spanning a second provider -- reported as scope for the finding, not as evidence that capability predicts calibration: a same-model comparison at a fixed external leaderboard score shows a deliberation-budget change alone moves the metric by nearly as much as a large cross-model gap. In a separate seat, conventional evaluation axes -- legality, cost, latency, completion rate -- can dissociate entirely from belief quality, with the configuration winning on every conventional axis producing the worst belief quality tested. A model exhibiting this pattern can still win the game its belief was about, which is why outcome-only evaluation would not detect it.
2608.24691.paper_summary_zh: 代理系統越來越多地將行動的門檻設置在模型自身所聲明的信心上，這假設信心在行動時刻能夠追蹤正確性。我們在一種隱藏信息的棋類變體中測試這一點，在這種變體中，王室身份可以在棋子之間秘密且重複地重新定位，並且一個代理對對手隱藏的王室棋子的聲明概率分佈——每回合都被引出，與它選擇的行動分開——將根據遊戲結束後可恢復的真實情況進行評分。在兩個獨立的批次中，對隱藏棋子位置的高聲明信心（$\geq 0.5$）所做的捕獲在62個案例中僅正確1次。這種校準缺陷幾乎完全集中在這些事件中：原始批次中99.3%的缺陷，重複批次中98.7%。相同的模式，在較弱的形式中，持續地（僅點估計；在這個樣本大小下，大多數成對差距在統計上無法區分）在四個進一步的模型配置中出現，這些配置跨越了第二個提供者——報告作為發現的範圍，而不是作為能力預測校準的證據：在固定的外部排行榜分數下進行的同模型比較顯示，僅僅改變深思預算就能使指標變化幾乎與大型跨模型差距一樣多。在另一個情境中，傳統評估軸——合法性、成本、延遲、完成率——可以與信念質量完全脫離，贏得每個傳統軸的配置卻產生了最差的信念質量。一個展現這種模式的模型仍然可以贏得其信念所關於的比賽，這就是為什麼僅僅基於結果的評估無法檢測到它的原因。
2608.24691.author: Bhushan Kashinath Joshi et.al.
